name: Matou Sakura
source:
A student in her first year of high school and the sister of [url=/c41]Matou Shinji[/url]. After [url=/c15]Shirou's[/url] father Kiritsugu died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores.

Though [url=/c41]Shinji[/url] is from a family of sorcerers, he asserts that she does not know her family's craft or history.

Sakura is outwardly timid but possesses high inner strength. She has a long-standing crush on Shirou.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
